It added the [[Polluted Wasteland II]] rework. This version contains two updates, the main v1.54.0 update (released 19 February 2025) and the minor v1.54.1 update (released 22 February 2025). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *Modern enemies: **''Blindly Shooting'' [[Scared Debuff]] decreased from 50% to 15%. **Summons changed. ***Summons are now no longer guaranteed to happen. The amount summoned is also far lower. ***New enemies: [[Splitter]] ***Removed enemies [[Toxic]], [[Super Toxic]], [[Slime]], [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]], [[Abomination]], [[Amalgamation]], [[Shadow Boss]], [[Super Mutant]] **[[Bloated]] added. *[[Ghoul]] and [[Reaver]] cash given on death is now mode dependent, meaning that by default they now give {{Money|3}} every 50% health lost. ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Polluted Wasteland II]] changed. **Wave structure changed. **Now moved over to its own mode instead of using the [[Challenge Maps]] system to alter legacy [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. **Level requirement increased from {{Level|25}} to {{Level|50}}. **Updated rewards. **Bonus triumph rewards added. ***Now has a 47.39% chance to give out one of these {{Color|Common}} items: ****{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} (3-6) ****{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} (3-5) ****{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} (3-5) ****[[Low Grade Crate]] ****[[Barricade]] (3-6) ****[[Supply Drop]] (2-6) ***Now has a 28.44% chance to give out one of these {{Color|Uncommon}} items: ****[[Cooldown Flag]] (2-6) ****[[Range Flag]] (3-6) ****[[Damage Flag]] (3-6) ****[[Mid Grade Crate]] ***Now has a 47.39% chance to give out one of these {{Color|Rare}} items: ****[[High Grade Crate]] ****[[Napalm Strike]] (3-5) ****[[Blizzard Bomb]] (3-5) ***Now has a 4.74% chance to give out one of these {{Color|Legendary}} items: ****[[Nuke]] ***Now has a 0.47% chance to give out one of these {{Color|Common|Custom}} items: ****[[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] **Consumables disabled. **Now uses the new income system with slight changes. Enemies now always give the same amount of cash on death, regardless of how much damage the player deals, but the amount is split between players, meaning in solo, an enemy gives 100% of its cash, 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. **Health scaling added, set to 25% in trio and 40% in quad. **[[Mutation]] health increase decreased from 8% to 5%. **Now plays ''Red Hex Temple'' on Wave 24. **Updated on which waves music starts playing. **Starting cash increased from {{Money|500}} to {{Money|1,150}}. **Mode type is now displayed as ''Special''. **[[Legacy]] removed. *Made enemies rotating on the paths look smoother. *Fixed enemy rotations not scaling with [[Time Scale]]. :In '''v1.54.1''': *Added the ability to purchase the following [[Developer Products]] on the main page: **{{Coins|5,000}} **{{Coins|10,000}} **{{Gem|1,500}} **{{Gem|2,500}} **{{ReviveTicket|3x Revive Tickets}} **{{SpinTicket|3x Spin Tickets}} **[[Premium Crate]] **[[Deluxe Crate]] **[[Lovestruck Crate]] *[[Lovestruck Crate]] and {{Color|Other|Game Master}} [[Crook Boss]] (purchase for self, not gift) [[Developer Products]] now have icons. *Fixed being able to bypass player count limits, allowing for up to six players. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.49.0Thumbnail.png FirstPersonMinigunnerThumbnail.png RocketeerThumbnail.png SquidGameThumbnail.png v1.53.0Thumbnail.png PWIIThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} v1.49.0Icon.png PollutedIcon2.png {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} V1.54.0Render.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log.
